領導統御.u: Usually a subject or object, as in "the ability of 領導統御" or "study 領導統御". Common in management, military, public service and corporate training, and often a course or book title. 領導 stresses giving direction and inspiring people; 統御 stresses managing and holding subordinates together. It is the umbrella concept covering 知人善任 (choosing the right people), 以身作則 (setting an example) and 賞罰分明 (fair rewards and discipline).
